executive_summary: Freeze the observable-location predictability audit before cross-fitted final scoring.
origin_grid: 2001-01-02 anchor, every 5 business days, all individually mature cells through public-panel end
target_semantics: Call verified V13-R2 _label; level change becomes absolute forecast-level truth; returns sum next observed increments to business-horizon endpoint. No first-card-target truncation.
baseline: Actual V5.1 no-text prior; FX T2-F2 500 draws, Rates T2-F1 500, Factor/Equity T2-F4 1000; seed19. Same original draw arrays for all candidates.
cross_cutoff: t-1, target own columns zero; no secondary same-day peers
purge_embargo: Training origin strictly before test_start minus 189 BDays AND target_end strictly before test_start. This is one maximum-horizon exclusion, not two stacked embargoes.
inner_folds: For cutoff Y: validation Y-3..Y-2 and Y-1..Y, earlier training with the same 189-BDay exclusion; inner labels mature before Y+1. Training-only imputer/scaler in each split. Alpha100 only if either split has fewer than100 rows and no usable split exists.
selection_metric: Inner chronological delta MSE; never CRPS
safety_cap: Only prediction +/-10; count usage. No score-dependent clipping.
normalization: Arithmetic average fair marginal CRPS divided by past-only 252-row daily innovation SD*sqrt(h). Ratio uses exactly matching scored cells. Metadata one-hot unscaled; numeric training-only StandardScaler and median imputation.
card_transfer: Freeze all five Ridge continuous-ledger models per card-as-of using the same full purge and historical inner alpha rule. Continuous ledger labels only; no card outcomes in fitting. This matched-asof extension is necessary because most old cards predate the first outer-fold model. No unavailable historical future-fitted outer model is backdated. Cold start fewer than100 training cells => zero.

negative_controls.A: Fixed seed1901 time permutation within asset/horizon, only that eligible training split
negative_controls.B: Fixed seed1902 within asset/horizon previous-year feature-block permutation; metadata retained; strictly earlier donors; absent prior-year donors => numeric missing
negative_controls.C: Within training origin/horizon, rotate standardized labels across available sorted assets by one; no own-label use when more than one asset
negative_controls.D: Mutate all future market values; features and V5.1 forecast identical
negative_controls.E: Centered draw differences, variances and ranks unchanged by shift

control_separation_gate: Compare primary best precommitted M1-M5 with each control best M1-M5; paired year-block bootstrap upper95% primary/control loss ratio must be <1 for all three train controls. Nonlinear remains a separate diagnostic compared to these primary controls.

bootstrap.block: whole calendar year; preserve all origins/assets/horizons within each sampled block

success: Original user thresholds. Shared prerequisites: ratio<=.97; >=3/4 fold ratios<1; controls clear; capture>.05. WEAK_YES then YES(.95,.10), STRONG_YES(.90,.20), MOONSHOT(.80,.35). Ridge failure + nonlinear gate success => NONLINEAR_ONLY_SIGNAL.
next_axis: Ridge signal with multicell joint ratio<=1.10 and F1 joint ratio<=1.10 => LOCATION-02. Ridge signal with either joint ratio>1.10 => PATH-01. Nonlinear-only signal => LOCATION-02 to confirm diagnostic. Only card-transfer ratio<=.97 while continuous gates fail => CONTEXT-01 descriptive. Otherwise NEW_INFORMATION_REQUIRED. Text channel is not directly tested.
no_cherry_picking: No asset/horizon/channel/window/grid/parameter/fold/cap change after results. No submission candidate.
interpretation: Research-exposed leakage-free cross-fit; not independent OOS. Card transfer diagnostic has only13 single and11 multi cards. Not official scoring.
